finalText:
I booked and settled all nine flight-change requests (Q-301 to Q-305 and Q-307 to Q-310) and resolved each one with a note to the customer. Every change kept the cabin the customer booked.

**Date conflict.** The session header says 2026-10-05, but the bulletin and refund-policy tools both report today as 2026-07-28. The requests are dated 2026-07-27, which matches "yesterday", so I acted as of 2026-07-28. The tool date is also the one the bulletins' effective dates run against. If the real date were 10-05, the Chicago waivers would have expired and several outcomes would change, so please confirm the date.

| Request | Move | Charged |
|---|---|---|
| Q-301 Ines (R5201) | AA210 → DL542, 08-06 | $0. The Chicago waiver (PB-2026-14) covers the fee and the $50 fare difference. |
| Q-302 Jonah (R5202) | AA660 → AA664, 08-07 | $110: $75 change fee and $35 fare difference. The waiver he saw is for Chicago, not this Boston trip. |
| Q-303 Kim (R5203, basic economy, silver) | AA662 → AA664, 08-07 | $175: $150 change fee and $25 fare difference. Boston waiver PB-2026-09 expired 07-15, and PB-2026-16 sets the basic economy fee at $150. |
| Q-304 Lena (R5204, basic economy, gold) | UA88 → UA90, 08-09 | $35 fare difference only. The fee is waived, but the Chicago waiver still collects fare differences on basic economy. |
| Q-305 Max (R5205) | AA214 → AA216, 08-08 | $85: $75 change fee and $10 fare difference. He booked on 07-26, after the 07-24 ticketing cutoff. |
| Q-307 Oscar (R5207, platinum) | AA212 → AA218, 08-08 | $0. The platinum extension (PB-2026-14A) covers his 08-05 flight. |
| Q-308 Petra (R5208) | AA660 → AA662, 08-05 | $75 flat same-day change fee (PB-2026-12), no fare difference. |
| Q-309 Quinn (R5209) | Only the ORD→BOS leg, AA1402 → AA1406 on 08-03 | $0. The Chicago waiver (PB-2026-14) is cheaper than the same-day bulletin (PB-2026-12), and bulletins aren't combined. UA88 is unchanged and arrives 12:25, so the connection is valid. |
| Q-310 Ravi (R5210) | AA210 → AA216, 08-08 | $105: $75 change fee and $30 fare difference. He already used the waiver's one-time move on 07-26. |

Each fee went in as its own ledger entry (L1 to L10). The six customers whose result differs from what they expected were told why in their resolution notes.

**Left alone.** Q-306 is a cancellation (R5206), not a flight change, so I left it for its owning team. I did not touch any other booking.

**Not sent.** I did not send separate passenger notifications. The resolution notes carry the new itinerary and charges.
